protected_note: package.json (all scripts) is guarded by QB's existing manifest gate: any change makes verification not_run (dependency_change_required)
agent_notice: Research task rule (identical for every arm). QB checks your change with this repository's visible Jest suite: `npm run build:clean`, `build:dist`, `build:types`, `build:prepare`, then `node node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --ci` with the CI environment variable unset (tests import src/). Files under __tests__/, jest.config.js and resources/{jestResolver.js,jestPreprocessor.js,rollup-config.mjs,prepare-dist.sh} are restored to the original before checking, and a changed package.json stops the check. Do not leave dist/ or npm/ in the workspace: a change there is refused as generated output. You can run the tests yourself with `node node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js` (no build needed).
